findings.description: The square sampler chooses x<n,x=n,x>n cases uniformly after base direction. For n=2, x=n is the singleton2, greatly overweighting target2 against neighboring3. When choices contain both2^(1/2) and3^(1/2), always choosing2^(1/2) succeeds127/136(93.4%) across512 fresh count5 batches. All2560 records survive separate read-only delivery filtering against basis4319; native grading confirms127 shortcut acceptances and9 rejections. The stronger baseline is50% between the two valid bases (blind five-choice baseline20%). This is a probabilistic incidental shortcut, not a mathematical error or a claim of a perfect predictor.
